label: Thermostat and water pump assembly coolant leak
symptom: Coolant smell from under the hood, visible wetness/crystallization around the pump assembly, or puddle of coolant on the floor.
cause: Leaking thermostat housing or water pump assembly.
fix: Replace the leaking component (thermostat housing, water pump, or assembly).
inspection_advice: Check under the hood for coolant residue or wetness around the thermostat and water pump area. Inspect the ground under the car for coolant puddles.
notes: Merged from thermostat housing leak, thermostat water pump assembly leak, leaking water pump/thermostat housing, and water pump leak issues.

label: Carbon buildup on intake valves causing misfire
symptom: Check engine light for misfire due to carbon buildup on intake, especially on cold startup. Performance loss, rough idle, or misfires.
cause: Carbon deposits accumulating on intake valves due to direct injection.
fix: Carbon cleaning service (walnut blasting or chemical cleaning).
warning_signs: ["Check engine light", "Misfire on cold startup", "Reduced power", "Rough idle", "Poor fuel economy"]
inspection_advice: Consider a borescope inspection of the intake valves if high mileage or symptoms are present.
notes: Merged from carbon buildup on intake valves and carbon buildup causing misfire issues.
